admission_logic: An invoice alone cannot pass: the actual T360 all-character/all-positive-tensor operator gate is mandatory, with 3,240 calls, 1,321,920 hosted rows, 112 ports and no axis-transfer overlay.
The operator receipt must reference the exact current complete owner invoice. Candidate/canonical-native hashes and the residual profile must agree.

Both native providers must report every ordered native/ledgers/local-replay/wrappers/phases stage with exit code zero; their exact words, complete output files and scientific sources are authenticated.
The top runner, inherited admission and release receipt must all be complete, have the same exact profile where supplied, and give the same rational final kappa.
The literal previous MOVES regression must admit its baseline, reject the candidate and authenticate its inputs.
The collector verifies complete scientific source/package manifests, stage-to-log hashes and exact retained bytes; the builder binds the collector and all retained files.

The final outer expression is min(valid BIT lower,valid complex lower)-10^-46-10^-70. The current complex lower binds. The reported .001745 target remains false and infinite-size hypotheses stay explicit.
